name: Illinois data center site leads and ComEd power evidence
method: Read the land and utility claims as attributed, keeping acreage scope, reported capacity, delivery timing and agreement status separate. The site leads are public profiles. Direct buyer availability and utility capacity were not verified.

site_leads.timing_as_published: Approximately 24–30 months on the Illinois EDC profile. Start date and utility commitment unspecified.
site_leads.next_check: Identify the study date, first available service block, and cost and timing for two diverse fiber entries.

site_leads.acreage_basis: City ownership of 130 acres plus an option on another 120 acres, as reported by Illinois EDC.
site_leads.timing_as_published: Two years for the 10 MW scenario with potential redundant service and five years for the higher scenario, per Illinois EDC. Start date unspecified.
site_leads.next_check: Confirm control of the optioned parcels and ask the utility what starts the clock for each block.

site_leads.acreage_basis: 365 acres described under option. Possible expansion to 3,000 acres involves multiple owners.
site_leads.timing_as_published: Potential after design and buildout of electric infrastructure. No delivery date published in the EDC profile.
site_leads.next_check: Verify who controls the option today, then request the utility study scope, construction obligations and first deliverable block.
